maria.sec: Found a public gist with a staging Postgres conn string (looks like a dev accidentally pasted it). gist.github.com/anon/abcd1234 :exclamation:
kevin.oncall: Seen it. Can you paste the exact conn string here (obfuscate the password) and confirm whether it’s prod or staging?
olivia.db: staging only — usr: redwood_staging, host: staging-db.internal, db: staging. Password appears exposed. Blast radius seems limited to staging DB.
maria.sec: Obfuscated: postgres://redwood_staging:****@staging-db.internal:5432/staging. No prod creds. Still want to treat as incident and rotate.
kevin.oncall: Agreed — step 1: disable the exposed user and rotate creds. Step 2: update Vault/KMS-backed secret and push to services. Step 3: audit gist and repo history. I'll coordinate. :point_up:
jordan.sre: For blast radius mitigation I recommend: 1) create new DB role + password, 2) revoke old_user LOGIN, 3) terminate existing connections for old_user, 4) update Vault kv, 5) trigger rolling restarts of staging apps. I can run the termination if you want.
olivia.db: Commands (psql on bastion):
```
psql "host=staging-db.internal user=admin dbname=postgres"
CREATE ROLE app_staging WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'NEW_STRONG_PW';
ALTER ROLE redwood_staging NOLOGIN;
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid)
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE usename = 'redwood_staging' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();
```
maria.sec: For Vault-backed flow if we have DB credentials stored in Vault KV path `secret/staging/db` we need to update that immediately after creating the new password. Also check whether secrets are wrapped/encrypted with cloud KMS key version — if so we'll rewrap.
jordan.sre: Vault steps I'll run after DB side is done:
```
vault login -method=oidc
vault kv put secret/staging/db connection_string="postgres://app_staging:NEW_STRONG_PW@staging-db.internal:5432/staging"
```
If you use a KMS envelope, rewrap step depends on provider — I can re-encrypt with a new key version if needed.
kevin.oncall: Who can push the Vault update and trigger canary deploy? I can do the DB rotation but need someone with Vault write perms. @jordan.sre can you take Vault write?
jordan.sre: I have perms. I'll wait for kevin to confirm DB user created and old login disabled.
olivia.db: After rotate, also update any terraform/helm values that may contain the connstring (search): `git grep -n "postgres://" || true` and scan gists/org gists for similar spills.
maria.sec: Timeline: rotate within 30m, update Vault and redeploy canary immediately after. Run log audit (Vault audit enabled?) and collect access logs for the last 72h.
jordan.sre: Vault audit is on — I will pull the audit logs for `secret/staging/db` and for KMS key ops once rotation is done and add to the incident ticket.
vault-bot: Vault: secret "secret/staging/db" updated by jordan.sre at 1865012900
kevin.oncall: Rotation started now — creating new role + setting password. Posting progress.
kevin.oncall: New role/app user created, old role set NOLOGIN, terminated sessions. DB-side done.
jordan.sre: Updating Vault now and kicking canary deploy for staging pods.
jordan.sre: Vault updated and canary deployed. Monitoring error rates and successful DB opens.
maria.sec: Good work. Please open an incident ticket with timeline, list of keys/creds rotated (DB user, Vault secret, any KMS rewrap), and follow-up action items: - review dev onboarding to avoid gist leaks - add git pre-commit filter to strip connection strings - run org-wide gist audit.
jordan.sre: Opening ENGSEC-4322 with timeline and logs. I'll attach Vault audit and RDS connection logs.
kevin.oncall: Confirming staging tests pass, no errors. Marking this as mitigated.
maria.sec: Thanks everyone. Postmortem and remediation items due EOD. :thumbsup:
